## Setup

```{r cars}
library(tidyverse)

transects <- st_read("data/processed/fuels_analysis.gpkg", layer = "transectsDS")

plots <- st_read("data/processed/fuels_analysis.gpkg", layer = "allplotsDS")
```

## Histograms of Transect Characteristics

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
